name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hxn GPU drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: Blend what a render pipeline draws into its target, with Blend.alpha, premultiplied, additive or a full blend state. Needs the drivers released with blending: hxn-gpu-metal 0.2.2, -vulkan 0.3.2, -d3d12 0.2.2, -gles 0.3.2, -webgpu 0.3.5, -webgl2 0.3.4.
